title: Warba Bank - Waves Wednesday Campaign
description: Warba Bank launched Waves, a new card/account platform with distinctive gradient card designs and a younger audience focus. Astroshot created a two-part campaign: a CGI awareness film where the four cards flew across Kuwait landmarks, and a playful 3D motion graphics explainer for Waves Wednesdays offers. The campaign was used across organic social and paid ads, giving Warba both launch awareness and a clear, entertaining way to explain the card benefits.
